messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "parenteral administration recommended for patients aged 6 months to 18 years"
set: ["parenteral administration recommended for patients aged 6 months to 18 years", "parenteral administration recommended", "oral administration recommended for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "parenteral administration recommended for patients aged 1 month to 12 years weighing less than 40 kg", "parenteral administration recommended for patients weighing 40 kg and greater", "oral administration recommended for patients 12 years and older", "oral administration recommended for MEC", "4 mg oral dose administered 3 times a day for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "take it every day for months or years", "weight loss increases over 6 to 12 months", "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "immediate-release (IR), ages 6 to 17 years", "immediate-release (IR), ages 6 to 11 years", "extended-release (XR), ages 6 to 12 years", "subsequent oral doses given 4 and 8 hours after first dose for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "4 to 6 weeks for full effects"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
